name: sonars
description: SONARS — Signal Observation, Navigation, Analysis & Response System for Devign Digital

scripts.build: node --check server.js routes/monitor.js routes/signals.js routes/health.js lib/db.js lib/worker-manager.js lib/security.js lib/config.js
scripts.lint: node --check server.js routes/monitor.js routes/signals.js routes/health.js lib/db.js lib/worker-manager.js lib/security.js lib/config.js frontend/app.js frontend/api.js frontend/components/signals-view.js frontend/components/dossier-modal.js frontend/components/config-view.js && python3 -m py_compile worker/worker.py worker/scoring.py worker/adapters/base.py worker/adapters/reddit.py
scripts.test: node --test tests/node/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/python -p 'test_*.py'
